import subprocess,json,urllib.request,datetime,hashlib,urllib.parse
ps=r'''$p=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='chrome.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match '--remote-debugging-port=17410' -and $_.CommandLine -notmatch '--type=' }; $p | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{pid=$_.ProcessId;parent=$_.ParentProcessId;created=[string]$_.CreationDate;flagThrottle=($_.CommandLine -like '*--disable-background-timer-throttling*');flagRenderer=($_.CommandLine -like '*--disable-renderer-backgrounding*');flagOcclusion=($_.CommandLine -like '*--disable-backgrounding-occluded-windows*')} } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress'''
p=subprocess.run(['powershell.exe','-NoProfile','-Command',ps],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8)
out={'at':datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds'),'processLookupExit':p.returncode}
try:
 raw=json.loads(p.stdout) if p.stdout.strip() else []
 out['ChromeMainProcesses']=[raw] if isinstance(raw,dict) else raw
except:out['processLookupError']='no_parsed_main_process'
ps2="Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter 'ProcessId=13436' | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ pid=$_.ProcessId; name=$_.Name; created=[string]$_.CreationDate } } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress"
p=subprocess.run(['powershell.exe','-NoProfile','-Command',ps2],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8)
try:out['oldChromePIDStillAlive']=json.loads(p.stdout) if p.stdout.strip() else None
except:out['oldChromePIDStillAlive']='QUERY_FAILED'
with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:17410/json/list',timeout=3) as r:pages=json.load(r)
extras={'26F93091439AEEBB8DB6788AD17BFA02':'extra-1','68D17114431457A201D7F164508E4318':'extra-2','6BBACA4F54475A91307D471FFBB8E0E5':'extra-3'}
out['previousExtraTargetsStillPresent']={alias:any(t.get('type')=='page' and t.get('id')==id for t in pages) for id,alias in extras.items()}
with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:17410/json/version',timeout=3) as r:version=json.load(r)
out['chromeVersion']=version.get('Browser')
out['currentPageCount']=len([t for t in pages if t.get('type')=='page'])
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=True)[:3700])

note: Read-only Chrome process+PID continuity and background flags booleans; compare original 3 extra target IDs; never output raw commandline, page URLs, or secrets; no browser changes.
